gates.requirement: The repository and full source commit SHA equal deployment pins, and the workflow head SHA matches.
The deployment-required test suite set executes and succeeds on the exact pinned source revision and workflow attempt.
The immutable artifact digest is pinned and its provenance binds the artifact to the source revision.
Required supply-chain provenance and SBOM attestations are present and verified against an independent trust policy.
Required vulnerability and admission-policy checks pass; skipped, missing, or unknown security results deny acceptance.
A trusted live health check observes the expected build and immutable artifact digest in the target production environment.

A fresh, source-pinned, same-build residual measurement is finite, lies in the topology-derived domain [0, 0.25], and satisfies the configured cone policy. G6 requires a Great Scale numericalCertification signed by an independent numerical-certificate key with its own fresh generatedAt/expiresAt, exact source/input/measurement digests, proof artifact matching proofDigest, and certified curvature/metric-area error upper bounds within tolerance. Empirical Richardson estimates are diagnostic only.
